title: Sprint C review fixes: the run-based claude gap closings cite DER facts, and an answer CODE tag gets its pointer
goal: the three _gaps.md entries closed on 2026-10-21 by our own claude -p runs (the --json-schema result size, --setting-sources "" with an empty value or the web search fee in total_cost_usd) each have the run written as a DER fact in claude/ci-and-headless.md; the last note of each of those entries is dated 2026-10-2x and cites that DER fact by path:line; the python.exe longPathAware answer in _answers.md gives each CODE source a path#symbol or path#Lx-Ly pointer

run:
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
L, A = 'public/_gaps.md', 'kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md'
K = ('--json-schema` has a retry count', '--setting-sources ""` (an empty value)', 'includes the web search fee')
art = open(A, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
bad = []
for e in kbfacts.ledger_entries(L):
    if not any(k in e['text'] for k in K):
        continue
    last = e['text'].rstrip().split('\n')[-1]
    refs = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'claude/ci-and-headless\.md:(\d+)', last)]
    ok = bool(re.search(r'- (?:Resolved|Partly resolved|Narrowed|Tried) 2026-10-2\d', last)) and refs and all(0 < n <= len(art) and '[DER' in art[n - 1] for n in refs)
    if not ok:
        bad.append(e['line'])
print(len(bad), 'of the three run-based entries whose last note does not cite a DER fact of', A, bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import re, sys
bad = [n for n, t in enumerate(open('kb/public/_answers.md', encoding='utf-8'), 1) if 'longPathAware' in t and re.search(r'\[CODE (?![^\]]*#)', t)]
print(len(bad), '_answers.md longPathAware lines with a CODE tag that has no pointer', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

the last note of each of those entries is dated 2026-10-2x and cites that DER fact by path:line
the python.exe longPathAware answer in _answers.md gives each CODE source a path#symbol or path#Lx-Ly pointer
